mainEntity.name: How long does it take to see results from AI geo-optimization?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeframe for seeing results from AI geo-optimization can vary depending on factors such as your current website authority, local market competition, and the scope of optimization. Generally, businesses might start observing initial improvements in local search visibility and traffic within 2-4 months. More significant and sustained gains, especially for highly competitive markets like Chicago or Houston, typically materialize over 6-12 months as the AI models learn and adapt to optimize performance continuously.
